shared_conditions: Same frozen sample, encoders where retained, original model settings, fitting and validation periods, stopping rule, threshold and seeds. No additional test-driven tuning.
scope: Minimal neural component evaluation. Three seeds provide limited training-variation evidence. Contrasts identify conditional predictive effects, not a full factorial interaction or semantic causality.
not_resolved: Traditional-model superiority requires same-history conventional baselines
Textual lead time requires separately dated signals and a numerical deterioration rule
formal_significance: Exploratory paired intervals only; do not claim familywise statistical significance.
data_requirement: Existing incident-v1.1 eligibility, baseline, follow-up and missingness rules remain unchanged. No training before registered sample freeze.
